subject.title: voice-call: media-stream WebSocket accepts unauthenticated start frames for non-Twilio providers (plivo, telnyx)

question: Should this public report be moved into private security handling, and what provider-neutral stream credential contract should voice-call enforce for non-Twilio media streams?
rationale: The source evidence supports an unauthenticated network path into active voice-call media handling, and SECURITY.md says active vulnerability details should be routed through private advisory handling rather than normal public repair automation.

options.title: Route Through Security Advisory
options.body: Move triage and the fix into the security-owned path, keep the public thread minimal, and patch provider-bound media-stream credentials across Twilio, Plivo, and Telnyx.

options.title: Patch Publicly Now
options.body: If maintainers decide the disclosure risk is already acceptable, land an immediate P0 public fix with focused regression proof for Twilio and non-Twilio start frames.

options.title: Downgrade To Hardening
options.body: Treat this as non-security only if maintainers decide `/voice/stream` is not reachable in a supported non-Twilio deployment, which the current source evidence does not prove.

recommendation.title: Route Through Security Advisory
recommendation.body: Move triage and the fix into the security-owned path, keep the public thread minimal, and patch provider-bound media-stream credentials across Twilio, Plivo, and Telnyx.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the current media-stream hardening history and prior triage of the related authentication report.
